items.name: kumo-base
items.title: Kumo base styles
items.description: Kumo's keyframes, helper classes and Tailwind token registration (from @cloudflare/kumo@2.19.1), all under kumo- names. Every Kumo component installs it. Add a theme item too.

[data-kumo-overflowing].mask-image:
linear-gradient(
      var(--scroll-fade-direction, to right),
      transparent,
      white calc(var(--kumo-fade-left-n) * var(--scroll-fade-width, 3rem)),
      white calc(100% - var(--kumo-fade-right-n) * var(--scroll-fade-width, 3rem)),
      transparent
    )

items.docs: Kumo components need exactly one theme item: kumo-theme (Kumo's own look), kumo-cloudflare (Kumo with the Cloudflare dashboard's sidebar) or kumo-binding (follows your shadcn theme). See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#themes

items.name: kumo-theme
items.title: Kumo theme
items.description: Kumo's own colors and type scale, as Kumo ships them (light, dark, and Kumo's fedramp theme). Install one theme item: kumo-theme, kumo-cloudflare or kumo-binding. From @cloudflare/kumo@2.19.1.
items.docs: Use one Kumo theme item at a time. To switch, delete the previous theme's rules from @layer base in your CSS file, then add the new one. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#themes

items.name: kumo-cloudflare
items.title: Kumo theme, Cloudflare dashboard variant
items.description: Kumo's own colors with the Cloudflare dashboard's direction: one highlight shade for every hover and selected background, and a canvas-colored sidebar. Install one theme item: kumo-theme, kumo-cloudflare or kumo-binding. From @cloudflare/kumo@2.19.1.
items.docs: Use one Kumo theme item at a time. To switch, delete the previous theme's rules from @layer base in your CSS file, then add the new one. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#themes

items.name: kumo-binding
items.title: Kumo binding to your shadcn theme
items.description: Sets Kumo's color tokens from your shadcn CSS variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, ...), so Kumo components follow your theme. Needs tailwind.cssVariables: true in components.json (with false there are no shadcn variables to read). Install one theme item: kumo-theme, kumo-cloudflare or kumo-binding.
items.docs: Use one Kumo theme item at a time. To switch, delete the previous theme's rules from @layer base in your CSS file, then add the new one. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#themes
